summary: NullPointerException when textHTML is not set

comments.content:
I expected the library to send a plain text only, when not setting textHTML
in the email, however, this produces a NPE.  This makes the library
unusable for sending plain text only.

For example:

    Email email = new Email();
    email.setFromAddress("sender", "xxx@xxx");
    email.setSubject("subject");
    email.addRecipient("recipient", "xxx@xxx", RecipientType.TO);
    email.setText("test mail");
    //email.setTextHTML("");
    Mailer mailer = new Mailer("smtp-server.xxx", 25, null, null);
    mailer.sendMail(email);

The above code (with valid email addresses and host name) produces a NPE on
the last line.  Uncommenting email.setTextHMTL("") eliminates the NPE.
